title: Integrated target package plus withdrawal autonomy
lean_kernel: Acyclic gluing; record assembly from independent obligations; controlled-invariant autonomy; explicit decoder-shadow counterexample.
python_support: Clause/gluing audit, withdrawal reachability, and one-obligation-removed enumeration.
landing_shape: A conditional structural theorem about target realization/autonomy, with lineage deliberately absent.
risk: Highest package-definition and nonvacuity risk; should be decomposed before any full theorem.
kill: No nontrivial MF-07-like positive model survives an independent clause and ownership audit.

title: Finite overlap-corridor lineage
lean_kernel: Corridor definition; concatenation; branching relation; endpoint-equality countermodel.
python_support: Event-graph corridor checker and branch classifier.
landing_shape: A conservative relation-valued process-lineage theorem and exact exclusion of detached copies under that criterion.
risk: Definition may smuggle continuity or become too permissive/too strict.
kill: A bounded counterexample breaks corridor composition or a detached reconstruction passes every noncircular condition.

title: Least relation-valued predictive ancestry
lean_kernel: Predictive partitions; finite monotone closure; leastness; fission/fusion; independent-twin exclusion.
python_support: Relation closure, derivation trees, quotient calculator, and finite counterexample search.
landing_shape: A computable heterogeneous ancestry relation with explicit branching and no unique-identity claim.
risk: Operational seed may function as an unexamined ancestry oracle.
kill: No seed/closure law separates source-derived reconstruction from an independent twin without circular language.

title: Shared finite no-go kernel

risk: A no-go may be true only for an overly restricted interface or criterion class.
